translations.text: Rather, he must be hospitable, a lover of what is good, sensible, just, holy, and self-controlled.
They must not pay attention to Jewish myths or to commands from people who turn away from the truth.
They profess to know God, but they deny him by their actions. They are detestable and disobedient, unfit for any good work.
They must not steal anything, but must show complete trustworthiness, so that in everything they may adorn the teaching of God our Savior.
He gave himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify us for himself as a special people, eager to do good works.
Speak these things, encourage, and rebuke with all authority. Do not let anyone look down on you.
Everyone with me sends you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.
